name: jsilnet
description: Dependency-free Node.js ECMA-335 / CLI assembly reader and writer

scripts.build:types: tsc --allowJs --checkJs false --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir src/types src/index.js
scripts.check:types: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext type-tests/core-api.ts && node scripts/check-type-coverage.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run check && npm run check:types
